mobile.signin.diagnostics.note: Reveal a redacted in-memory log containing stage names and error classes only.

mobile.signin.failed.note: Unexpected sign-in or credential persistence failure; never show runtime messages or credentials.

mobile.signin.hide_diagnostics.note: Sign-in support disclosure. Human-readable stage or show/hide control; no credential, URL, token, code or state value.

mobile.signin.progress.note: Visible after the native browser returns, during token exchange and credential persistence.

mobile.signin.retry.note: Retry a failed or cancelled sign-in.

mobile.signin.show_diagnostics.note: Sign-in support disclosure. Human-readable stage or show/hide control; no credential, URL, token, code or state value.
